post.summary:
Create a lesson inside a course. Send the video either as videoFile (multipart) or as
videoUrl; a file always wins over the link. studyBookFile is the optional summary
document. Marking isFreeDemo keeps the lesson open to guests. The response carries the
stored tokens; play the video from /files/{videoUrl}.

application/json.value: { "success": false, "message": "The submitted data is invalid.", "data": null, "statusCode": 400 }

put.summary:
Update a lesson. Omitting both videoFile and videoUrl keeps the current video; sending
studyBookUrl empty removes the study book, omitting the field keeps it. A new upload
replaces and deletes the old file. Moving a lesson to another course is not supported;
delete and recreate it instead.

application/json.value: { "success": false, "message": "The submitted data is invalid.", "data": null, "statusCode": 400 }

post.summary:
[Student] Book a session by instructor and date only. The backend picks the first open availability
window of that day that fits the requested duration and clashes with nothing, and snapshots its times
onto the session, so a later change to the instructor's availability never moves an already booked
session. The backend also decides the billing: while the student has never taken a lesson, this booking
becomes the free trial and needs no wallet hours; afterwards it is charged, and the lesson hours
(1.0 for 50m, 0.5 for 25m) must already be in the student's active plan wallet to be deducted on payment.

BookableSlotDto.description:
One dated window the learner can actually book: an open availability row with no live session
inside it yet.

CancelSessionCommand.description:
One call for both sides. The actor decides the lock: the teacher gets 24 h before the start, the
learner 12 h. A learner cancels their own seat; the session itself goes with it only when nobody
is left holding one.
